responsibility: Implements small adapter helpers that extract common metadata from different Rust AST path-segment node classes. In the frontend’s path and name-handling utilities, this file provides the concrete overloads that return a segment’s NodeId for TypePathSegment, SimplePathSegment, and PathExprSegment, and it exposes lang-item extraction where only type path segments can carry one, giving later analysis code a uniform way to query segment identity and optional LangItem::Kind across heterogeneous AST segment types.
same_name_distinction: Supplies the concrete overload bodies for the segment-helper API declared by the matching header, implementing NodeId extraction for each segment class and the lang-item check that only returns a value for TypePathSegment. Unlike rust-unwrap-segment.h, it does not provide the generic template/macro unwrapping layer or inline unique_ptr forwarding interface.
